actual: Dozens of merged/squash-merged branches, close-sync worktrees, backup branches, and dirty worktrees remained after historical flows; cleanup required manual audits and consumed time/tokens.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: Dozens of merged/squash-merged branches, close-sync worktrees, backup branches, and dirty worktrees remained after historical flows; cleanup required manual audits and consumed time/tokens.
evidence_uris: 2026-07-07 branch/worktree cleanup audit: 94 worktrees before cleanup; many PR MERGED source branches remained because squash merge HEAD was not ancestor of main.
expected: Merge/close-sync aftercare should classify and clean merged or squash-merged source branches/worktrees when safe, keep open PR/dirty worktrees, classify backup/temp TTL candidates, and expose compact cleanup guidance for Codex and Claude without large token overhead.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
reproduce_command: git worktree list --porcelain; git branch --format %(refname:short); gh pr list --state all --limit 500 --json number,headRefName,state,mergedAt
title: merge aftercare cleanup does not reliably prune squash-merged branches and stale worktrees
